entities.title: Bars on State Security's file
entities.summary: The report shows each popularity and strength as a bar beside its digit, in Samosa's own colours and layout.
entities.context: The original's report showed values as bars. A bar for a 0–9 value is an idea, not expression, but the report's look must not resemble the original's.
entities.decision: Each value gets a bar of 0–9 units, 4 pixels each, after its digit: cyan for popularity, magenta for strength, on the dark file. The report never flashes and marks plots in words.
entities.rationale: Easier to read at a glance; only the idea of a bar is shared (docs/PROVENANCE.md).

entities.title: State Security's screens are dark
entities.summary: The report and the report offer are white type on black paper.
entities.context: Each office of the palace has its own colour family (ART-BIBLE §3).
entities.decision: State Security's screens use the dossier family: white on black, with a manila tab.
